notes:
v1.0.37 — CurseForge is now connected out of the box.

CurseForge browsing (Mods, Resource Packs, Data Packs, Shaders) now works
immediately after updating: the launcher ships with the Reimagined CurseForge
proxy URL pre-configured as the default. The proxy keeps the CurseForge API
key on the server side only (your own backend/cf-proxy instance) — the key
never touches your PC or the repository. Anyone can still change or clear the
proxy URL in Settings → Advanced → CurseForge proxy URL.

Everything from v1.0.36 remains: the join-crash fix (FPS Boost 1.0.12),
reliable auto-relaunch after updates, the premium startup + Downloads
redesign, and the enhanced Check-for-Updates modal.
